projects.name: NLP Sentiment Signals & Equity Volatility (Dissertation)
projects.description: Built a FinBERT-based sentiment classifier over financial text to test whether social-media sentiment predicts equity price volatility
projects.outcomes: Delivered a rigorous, reproducible study; the sentiment signal showed no significant predictive edge — a clean null result honestly reported
projects.problem_solved: Isolating usable signal from noisy, high-volume financial social-media data

projects.name: CV Builder & Job-Fit Scorer
projects.description: A Python CLI that builds an ATS-ready CV, scores it against any job description, and tailors it to the role, with an optional Claude API upgrade
projects.outcomes: Deterministic, offline scoring engine plus a pluggable LLM seam; published as an open-source repo
projects.problem_solved: Tailoring a CV to a specific job quickly, without paying for a service or leaking data to one

projects.name: Grid-World RPG
